spec.name: Quiet names v4
spec.notes: Long the calm names, short the jumpy ones.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.1, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 5%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses 'index_member_now' in the signal definition, which introduces lookahead bias by using current index membership to determine historical portfolio weights. This means the backtest assumes knowledge of future index constituents, which is not possible in a real-world trading environment. Additionally, the research log indicates a very small number of trials (5), suggesting the strategy has not been rigorously stress-tested against overfitting. Given the lookahead bias, the performance metrics are unreliable. I recommend paper trading to verify if the strategy holds up when index membership is handled correctly using point-in-time data.
